AppImage launcher/runtime and generated hook notices

AppRun.wrapped is the unmodified Tauri apprun-old x86_64 release asset:
SHA256 f30140a43a0a59e46db21bdefdf749b9e9f2c6946e92afabbacf98b8ae73fb4f.
The release describes an AppImageKit continuous mirror, but provides no exact
source revision. AppImageKit's MIT notice and AppRun.c (including its original
Simon Peter/RazZziel copyright notice) are supplied as notices/reference source,
not a claim that that revision reproduces the mirrored binary.

The GTK runtime hook is generated by the byte-verified script in Tauri CLI
2.12.1, commit 30da1fd6e17de6107ecc850c95dfb16b5729f2dd. The upstream GTK-plugin
MIT notice, Tauri MIT/Apache notices and linuxdeploy MIT notice are included.
The actual generated hook is inventoried by SHA256 in appimage-tools.json.

The outer runtime identifies itself as AppImage/type2-runtime commit
8f39b89e2ac31e1640b3d3f7e9a5108e6ce805fa. Its build scripts statically link fuse
3.15.0 (including patches/libfuse/mount.c.diff), squashfuse 0.5.2, musl, zstd,
zlib and mimalloc. Mimalloc is present in its Makefile although omitted from
its top-level license list. Original notices for all these are included here.
Permissive-library notice URLs identify the copies consulted, not a measurement
of every static library's exact embedded version.

The companion sources/tools directory contains the runtime's exact source tree
and build instructions, patched-fuse input and squashfuse input, with download
SHA256s. The two dependency archive hashes match the runtime's pinned build
script. Retain that directory with distribution. The complete runtime source
and patch/build recipe permit rebuilding/relinking with modified libfuse; no
VeekPanel production source or proprietary object is needed for that runtime.
A byte-for-byte runtime rebuild has not been performed. See upstream BUILD.md.

The companion native SRPMs include the source archives, distribution patches
and RPM build recipes for every inventoried RPM source package. Nothing here
imposes additional restrictions on modifying/replacing/relinking those libraries.
Do not distribute a binary-only copy while omitting its companion notices/sources.

PROVENANCE.json records the URL and SHA256 of every original notice/reference
file. This inventory is engineering evidence, not a legal certification.
